name: Ikeshti Ancient Rivener
body:
IKESHTI ANCIENT RIVENER
CR 14

XP 38,400
N Large humanoid (ikeshti, reptilian)
Init +9; Senses Perception +20

DEFENSE

AC 29, touch 14, flat-footed 24 (–1 size, +5 Dex, +15 natural)
hp 204 (20d8+114)
Fort +12, Ref +18, Will +12
Defensive Abilities ferocity, violent instincts; Resist cold 15, fire 15

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., climb 15 ft.
Melee bite +23 (2d6+7 B&P&S, 19–20/×2), 2 claws +23 (1d6+7 B&S plus bleed), gore +23 (1d8+7 P)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks bleed (1d6), pounce, squirt blood (4/day, DC 26 Fort, 30 ft.)

STATISTICS

Str 25 (+7), Dex 20 (+5), Con 22 (+6), Int 5 (–3), Wis 18 (+4), Cha 10 (+0)
Base Atk +15; CMB +21; CMD 36
Feats Blind-Fight, Critical Reflexes, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Natural Attack (bite), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Power Attack, Run, Skill Focus (Perception), Skill Focus (Stealth)
Skills Climb +13, Perception +20, Stealth +17, Survival +4 (+8 in deserts); Species Modifiers +4 Survival in deserts
Languages Draconic (can speak and understand simple words only)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Squirt Blood (Ex)

As brood-minder.

Violent Instincts (Ex)

An ancient rivener attacks the nearest creature when confused instead of any other effect, and ignores magical commands compelling them to do anything other than attack.

ECOLOGY

Environment any deserts, hills, or mountains
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

Native to desert worlds, ikeshti are small reptilian humanoids with rust-colored scales. Various spines, fins, and horns grow along their heads, backs, and tails, helping to regulate their body temperature in the harsh desert climate. Hormonal changes in ikeshti can produce specialized variations of the species—including the following examples.

Specialized ikeshti who tend to the eggclutches and the young who emerge from them, brood minders are known for their detached, almost robotic personalities—and for obsessively defending their wards.

Meanwhile, many ikeshti exiled into the harsh desert go mad from the experience, transforming into near-mindless predators with razor-sharp claws and horns. These monsters continue to grow larger and more fearsome with each passing year, with those who survive long enough ultimately becoming ancient riveners.
